tools.name: shiyu_worker_probe_task
tools.description: 受限任务工具占位：仅用于证明 worker 工具预算与事件工具共同装配，探针中不可执行。

tools.name: shiyu_worker_event_types
tools.description: Discover the event report types this Assignment may publish. Returns type, schema version, payload fields, required fields, filterable fields and the trusted assignment scope. This grants nothing and cannot subscribe, wake a model or change task state.

tools.name: shiyu_worker_event_report
tools.description: Publish one scoped observation or reported result for this Assignment. Actor, scope, source trust level and allowed types are injected by the trusted runtime; they cannot be supplied in arguments. Reserved success facts (task.succeeded), verification receipts, owner grants and accounting facts are rejected. Retry with the same idempotencyKey and identical content.

payload.description: Exactly the registered payload fields. Maximum input 16 KiB; each string at most 8192 characters.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity for this logical report, 1–256 characters; keep unchanged across retries.
